title: Vanguards tuning
description: Gameplay tuning owned by the Vanguards domain (ADR-008 §2, §5): each Vanguard's body, stats, growth, basic attack, kit and passive, keyed by content ID, and each passive archetype's records. VeyraVanguards binds it to FVeyraVanguardsTuning. test_vanguard is the developer test Vanguard, the successor of the M3 developer loadout.

stats.description: Base stats (FVeyraStatBlock): Max Health, Move Speed and Attack Speed above 0, the rest at least 0.

healthRegen.description: Health per second, in and out of combat (Combat Bible §6; ADR-011 §11).

growth.description: What each level after the first adds to the base stats (Economy & Progression Bible §9).

attackSpeedFraction.description: Each level adds this fraction of the level-1 Attack Speed.

shape.description: A hit shape (ADR-009 §4). Each kind uses its own sizes; the others are 0.

homingProjectile.description: A homing projectile, which terrain does not stop (ADR-008 §9).

damage.description: One damage component: the amount plus the owner's power times the ratios (Combat Bible §25).

amountByRank.description: One value: a passive has no ranks.

secondaryImpact.description: An explosion behind a basic attack's target, facing away from the attacker; the target itself is never hit by it (ADR-009 §5).

priority.description: A higher priority replaces a lower one; an attack keeps one impact.

statuses.description: Status IDs from Abilities.json's statuses map.

basicAttack.description: How the Vanguard's basic attacks work (Combat Bible §4, §48; ADR-008 §2).

range.description: Edge to edge, in units (Combat Bible §40).

damageType.description: Physical unless the Vanguard overrides it (Combat Bible §4).

windupFraction.description: The part of each attack's interval before Commit; the rest is backswing.

acquisitionRadius.description: How far past the Vanguard's edge attack-move looks for an enemy.

minimumIntervalSeconds.description: The shortest time between attacks whatever the Attack Speed; 0 for none.

projectile.description: A ranged attack's homing projectile; empty for melee.

cleave.description: Where the attack cleaves when something makes it cleave: at the Vanguard, facing its target.

shield.description: A shield granted to the Vanguard (Combat Bible §7, §51; ADR-009 §3): the amount plus Max Health and Magic Power times the ratios.

amountByRank.description: A passive's shield has one value.

maxAmountMaxHealthRatio.description: The most a merged shield holds, as a fraction of Max Health.

schemaVersion.description: Version of this file's format. A build reads exactly one version.

vanguards.description: Every Vanguard, keyed by its stable ID (ADR-008 §2).

availability.description: Playable Vanguards are released: players may own and pick them, and the backend's catalog lists them (ADR-010 §6). Developer Vanguards exist for tests and development servers only; a Shipping match server refuses them.

resource.description: What the Vanguard spends to cast (Combat Bible §27).

capsuleRadius.description: The body's radius, which ranges measure from (Combat Bible §40).

capsuleHalfHeight.description: Including the rounded ends, so at least the radius.

abilities.description: The ability in each slot, from Abilities.json; R is the ultimate.

passive.description: The passive, from one of the passive maps.

deepFoundation.description: Passives that shield their Vanguard when one of its abilities immobilizes an enemy Vanguard (Cairn's Deep Foundation, Character Bible §18).

shield.description: The shield each immobilized enemy Vanguard grants.

lockoutSeconds.description: How long the same enemy Vanguard cannot grant the shield again.

hitChain.description: Generic passives that build up over the hit chain, consecutive basic attacks on one enemy Vanguard, and fall off when it ends (ADR-008 §5; Qazharr's Sea Dog, Character Bible §13).

status.description: A status from Abilities.json's statuses map, applied again by each attack in the chain: a stacking status gains a stack per hit.

gatheringLight.description: Passives that gather a stack from each damaging cast that hits an enemy Vanguard and, once primed, send a homing fragment with the next (Oriel's Gathering Light, Character Bible §20).

stacksToPrime.description: Stacks that prime it; canon gives three.

fragmentDamage.description: The fragment's damage, prepared when it launches.

breach.description: Passives that, on every Nth consecutive basic attack on the same enemy Vanguard, add damage and an explosion behind the target (Bryn's Breach, Character Bible §19).

hitsToBreach.description: Which consecutive hit breaches; canon gives the third.

bonusDamage.description: Added to the breaching attack's own damage.

impact.description: The explosion behind the target; a higher-priority impact such as Breach Round's replaces it.

movingTarget.description: Passives that Track enemy Vanguards their owner or an ally displaces, for range and bonus damage against them, and bank the displacement toward an empowered attack (Kade's Moving Target and Dead Reckoning, Roster Bible §2).

trackedStatus.description: From Abilities.json's statuses, applied by the owner: a source-relative range.

trackedDamage.description: Added to the owner's attacks on a target it has Tracked.

thresholdUnits.description: Units of displacement banked before the next attack on a Tracked target spends them.
